tools.name: search_printables
tools.description: Search Sage's free color-by-number math printables for ages 4-8 (grades K-2). Newest first when browsing, most relevant first with a query. Each result has an id for get_printable, a pageUrl to print or download from, and imageUrl, the worksheet PNG. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

tools.name: get_printable
tools.description: Get one printable by the id from search_printables: its title, the day in history it marks, the short story printed with it, its color key, and links to print or download it.
